'''Waleutto Yobariok's estate''' was an estate belonging to the eccentric merchant [[Waleutto Yobariok]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was said to have been served by a [[Waleutto Yobariok's protocol droid|gold-plated]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] in his mansion, a rumor that was confirmed when treasure hunters discovered the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in the estate's basement.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Extravagant Possessions}}</ref>
